Body.Content:
What and why

To help organizations create and manage Brand Kits more efficiently, Microsoft is introducing the ability for Brand Managers and Brand Kit owners to duplicate an existing Brand Kit and use it as the starting point for a new one. This capability makes it easier to reuse an existing brand setup when creating Brand Kits for different brands, regions, or template variations, reducing the need to recreate settings from scratch.

Rollout schedule

  • General Availability (Worldwide): Available now

Impact on your organization

Who is affected

  • Brand Managers
  • Brand Kit owners with access to Brand Kit

Platforms and services

  • Brand Kit

What will happen

  • Brand Managers and Brand Kit owners can create a new Brand Kit by duplicating an existing one.
  • The duplicated Brand Kit can be used as a starting point and customized as needed.
  • This capability reduces manual effort when creating multiple Brand Kits with similar branding requirements.
  • The feature is available to Brand Managers and Brand Kit owners with access to Brand Kit.

Action required and recommendations

No action is required.

You may want to:

  • Inform Brand Managers and Brand Kit owners about this new capability.
  • Review any internal documentation or processes related to Brand Kit creation and management.

Compliance considerations

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.

Title: Microsoft Brand Kit: Duplicate an existing Brand Kit
